text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot: the mean net power over one weekday hour (CAMS hour ending 11:00 to 14:00 UTC, May to August) against that hour's CAMS irradiance. Black lines: least-squares fits below 500 W/m² and above 600 W/m² for summer 2025.'
text.tspan: Each dot: the mean net power over one weekday hour (CAMS hour ending 11:00 to 14:00 UTC, May to
August) against that hour's CAMS irradiance. Black lines: least-squares fits below 500 W/m² and
